name: ps5-100-million-shipped-sony-nov-11
headline:
شحنات PS5 تتخطى
حاجز 100 مليون
line:
حسب بيانات سوني (Sony):
أكثر من 100 مليون جهاز
شُحنت حتى 10 نوفمبر
label: رسمي

angle.hook: The PS5 has passed 100 million units shipped, six years after launch, Sony's own site shows
angle.why_now: Sony Interactive Entertainment updated its Business Data and Sales page with the figure as of 10 November, days before GTA 6 launches on the console
angle.what_it_means_here: It puts the PS5 among the four PlayStation consoles above 100 million, though the figure counts shipments to retailers and not consumer purchases
